mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% MoM does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of rising CPI and falling UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS level relative to 12-month MA does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decrease in housing starts (HOUST) during a recession signals reduced consumer confidence and demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances during a recession despite negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 5% MoM does not correlate with subsequent negative returns during recessions.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of decreasing Industrial Production (INDPRO) and increasing Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates supply constraints amidst strong demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM and RSAFS increases > 1% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of decreasing INDPRO and increasing RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.
